title: feat(spec,objectql,plugin-security): a hook reads principalKind, so an AI service account is recognised as an agent (ADR-0151 O4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XmJcoZFjfvaX78SFvouo2e)_
Fixes #31740

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — triage files the `domain:skills` child that teaches hook authors `ctx.session.principalKind` (triage comment 6730398547, rule 5)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：hook 现在能读 `ctx.session.principalKind`(human / agent / service / guest / system),从请求的执行上下文原样拷贝。OAuth 代理和 AI 服务账号都读 `agent`;管理员代查他人权限(explain `?userId=`)时，人类主体现在显示 `human`。审计行不变，只加 pin。
- 为什么改:ADR-0151 D5 / O4。以前 hook 只能从 `performedByClientId` 认出代理，服务账号永远没有它，看起来像人;O2 治理拦截和 O6 审批路由要对两类代理问同一个问题。
- 风险与回滚：新增一个可选的只读键，不读它的 hook 没有任何变化;不默认补 `human`,所以丢了 kind 的上下文不会把代理报成人。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/engine-execution-plumbing.ts`(buildSession 的拷贝点)、`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-explain-access.ts`(代查分支盖 `human`)、`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts`(新键与说明)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/agent-dual-attribution.integration.test.ts`,预期 9 个用例全过，其中账号写入的 hook 读到 `agent`、审计行 `user_id` 是账号本身。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`** — `HookContextSchema.session.principalKind`: `z.enum(['human','agent','service','guest','system']).optional()`, the envelope's own name and value set (`ExecutionContext.principalKind`), with a `.describe()` that says it is descriptive only and how the two kinds of agent differ (`provenance.performedByClientId` set for an OAuth client acting for a person, absent for an AI service account acting as itself). `content/docs/references/data/hook.mdx` regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, only `check:docs` was stale).
- **`@objectstack/objectql`** — `buildSession()` copies `execCtx.principalKind` verbatim onto a session that already exists, after the presence test (the same placement `locale` has), so a kind alone never creates a session; it never defaults to `'human'`.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-security`** — the explain-access branch that explains ANOTHER user (`?userId=`) stamps `principalKind: 'human'` when the resolver named no kind (the row's existence is already asserted there). An AI service account already read `'agent'` (O3). The exported `buildContextForUser` is untouched. Evaluation is unchanged: only `'agent'` and `'guest'` steer any decision, and `'human'` vs absent differ only in the permission-set memo key.
- **Audit writers** (`plugin-audit` `audit-writers.ts`, `action-invocation-audit.ts`, `data-export-audit.ts`) — **no change**; each takes `user_id` from the envelope's `userId`, which for an account is the account. Pinned below.
- Not built, per ADR-0151 D5: a `performedBy` naming the account, any audit kind column (ADR-0118 D5), a per-write key id.
- Changeset `.changeset/31740-principal-kind-reaches-hooks-and-explain.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/plugin-security` patch (`plugin-audit` changes tests only).
- Seat rulings applied (claim amendment 6755781269): key name and placement, spec carried in this card (precedent #30800, the `protocol:data` label is expected), no `'human'` default, explain stamp only in the query-for-another-user branch.

## Tests

New pins, no existing assertion changed (no forced test edits):

- `packages/spec/src/data/hook.test.ts` — the five values parse and survive, a sixth is refused at `['session','principalKind']`, the type carries the key.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-execution-plumbing.session-locale.test.ts` (top-level describe) — through the real assembler an account reads `agent` with itself as `userId`; CONTROL a person reads `human`; five values copied verbatim; no kind ⇒ no key (never a defaulted `human`); a kind alone ⇒ no session.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/agent-dual-attribution.integration.test.ts` (top-level describe, real ObjectQL + sqlite-wasm + the shipped writer, envelopes from the real assembler): a hook on the audited object reads `agent` + `performedByClientId` for the OAuth client, `agent` with no `performedByClientId` for the account, CONTROL `human` for the person; the account's ledger row has `user_id` = `actor` = the account, `metadata` null, no kind column.
- `action-invocation-audit.test.ts`, `data-export-audit.test.ts` — an account's action call and export: `user_id` = `actor` = the account, no `performed_by`, no `on_behalf_of`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-removed-member-principal.test.ts` — the rig gains an AI service account member (fixture addition only); new describe: an administrator's explanation of a person reads `human` (CONTROL: the person's own request through the door carries `human`), of the account `agent`.

Ablations (each mutation landed on disk per `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, ran red, restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):

| # | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `buildSession` defaults the kind to `'human'` | objectql: "never a defaulted human" |
| A2 | kind copied before the presence test | objectql: "a kind alone does not make a session" + the existing guest CONTROL |
| A3 | copy deleted | objectql: account `agent`, person `human`, five values |
| B1 | CRUD writer writes metadata for an agent principal | plugin-audit integration: account row names no performer/delegator/kind |
| B2 | export writer writes the delegation pair for an agent principal | export: account row names no performer/delegator |
| B3 | action writer writes the delegation pair for an agent principal | action: account row names no performer/delegator |
| C1 | explain stamp deleted | plugin-security: person explained by an administrator reads `human` |
| C2 | copy removed in objectql, objectql rebuilt (plugin-audit reads objectql `dist/`) | plugin-audit hook pins (2 red); restore + rebuild ⇒ 9/9 green, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` clean |

C2 note: the first marker was a code comment the bundler strips, so the mutated-leg `ablation-dist-preflight` could not see it; the red-on-rebuild / green-on-restore-rebuild pair is the evidence the mutation reached `dist/`.

## Acceptance notes

- The Console's access-explain panel (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AccessExplainPanel.tsx`) shows `onBehalfOf` and `posture` but not `principal.principalKind`. Showing it belongs to the UI lane; named as a follow-up by the seat, not built here.
- An action body's `ctx.session` (`runtime/src/action-execution.ts` `buildActionSession`) is a different object from `HookContext.session` and does not carry the key; out of this card's scope.
- `'service'` and `'system'` have no producer today; the key copies whatever the envelope says.
